# Furniture Disposal Plus

> Nationwide furniture removal and haul-away with upfront, item-level pricing. First item from $90, each additional item from $20. The price shown before booking is the price paid, including all labor, loading, hauling, and disposal or donation drop-off. Same-day and next-day pickup in most areas across all 50 US states. A brand of LoadUp Technologies, LLC (founded 2014, Alpharetta, Georgia). Pickups are performed by a nationwide network of vetted independent Loaders.

Key facts:
- Pricing: first item from $90, additional items from $20, no fuel or stair fees
- Booking: online, no phone call or on-site estimate required
- Presence not required if the item is accessible
- Donation-first: usable furniture goes to local donation centers, then recycling, then disposal
- Every item page includes to-scale size guidance versus a standard 32 by 80 inch doorway
